name: kaafil-qa-handoff
description: Sharma Travels Admin — a working mock partner CRM you integrate the Kaafil React UI Kit into.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names server,app --prefix-colors cyan,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "pnpm run dev:server" "pnpm run dev:app"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && vite build app

comment:dev:server: Deliberately NOT `tsx watch`. Booting this server wipes crm.sqlite, re-seeds it and pushes the whole fixture into your Kaafil tenant; a file-watcher restart would replay that ingest on every keystroke and burn your rate limit. Restart it by hand when you change server code.
comment:secrets: KAAFIL_API_KEY is read by `tsx --env-file=.env` in the server/tooling scripts only. `vite app` is started without it, so there is no path by which the key can reach a browser bundle.
